name: @pipeworx/mcp-statbel-be

tools.name: list_views
tools.description: Browse/search Statbel (Statistics Belgium, be.STAT) saved statistical views. Each view is a pre-built table over a dataset and carries a single locale (nl/fr/de/en). Returns id, name, locale, dataSourceId and publish dates. Filter by case-insensitive substring of the view name (matches in any language).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match in the view name (any language). Omit to list all.

locale.description: Optional filter to one language: "nl", "fr", "de" or "en".

tools.name: get_view
tools.description: Metadata for one Statbel view by its id (a UUID, e.g. from list_views). Returns the view object: name, locale, dataSourceId (the underlying dataset), and publish/change dates. To get the dataset description in all available languages, pass the returned dataSourceId to get_dataset.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Browse/search Statbel datasets (be.STAT "datasources"). Each dataset has a `name` code (e.g. "IM_EAF_HOUSE_SALES_IDX"), a `descriptions` map with one entry per supported language (nl/fr/de/en), a category id, supportedLocales, and last-update timestamps. Filter by case-insensitive substring matched against the dataset code and all-language descriptions.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the dataset code and any-language description. Omit to list all.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Multilingual metadata for one Statbel dataset by its id (a UUID, e.g. the dataSourceId from a view). Returns the dataset code `name`, the `descriptions` map (nl/fr/de/en text), supportedLocales, defaultLocale, category id and update dates.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-statbel-be forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the statbel-be pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
